title: Seoul - Busan in 10 days
description:
Explore the vibrant cities of Seoul and Busan in just 10 days, experiencing their
rich culture, delicious food, and unique sights. This guide takes you through must-
visit spots, local experiences, and tips to make the most of your trip. Get ready to
discover the perfect blend of tradition and modernity in South Korea’s top
destinations.

title: Short Upper Mustang Trek | Explore
description:
Short Upper Mustang Trek Explore Mustang in 7-10 Days
Embark on an unforgettable journey through the mystical landscapes of Upper
Mustang with our Short Upper Mustang Trek. Designed for adventure seekers with
limited time, this 7-10 day trek o ff ers a perfect blend of Nepal’s cultural heritage,
ancient Tibetan villages, and stunning desert-like scenery. Explore hidden caves,
monasteries, and the unique Mustang architecture while trekking through Lo
Manthang, the walled city at the heart of Upper Mustang.
This Mustang trekking itinerary is ideal for travelers looking to experience high-
altitude trekking in Nepal, witness the breathtaking Himalayan views, and
immerse themselves in the rich Tibetan-in fl uenced culture. The trek covers
moderate distances each day, with manageable altitudes, making it suitable for
both novice and experienced trekkers.
Experience the charm of Mustang’s remote trails, traditional homestays, and
vibrant local festivals. Our Upper Mustang trek package includes guided tours,

accommodations, and meals, ensuring a hassle-free adventure. Whether you are
a solo traveler, couple, or small group, this short trek provides a once-in-a-lifetime
Himalayan experience without the need for a long expedition.
